    Injective labels and essential surjectivity (Proposition 2.10) #

    graded-category.tex: "Write S_x = P_x/rad P_x … Since dim C(P_y, S_x) = dim Hom_A(P_y, S_x) = δ_{xy}, its evaluation is the simple A₀-module S_x⁰. For the original injective I_x = D_k(Ae_x), put N_x = ev(R_{I_x}). … full faithfulness gives dim Hom_{A₀}(S_y⁰, N_x) = dim C(S_y, I_x) = δ_{xy}. Thus soc N_x = S_x⁰. Also dim N_x e_y = dim C(P_y, I_x) = … = dim e_y A₀ e_x. Extend the inclusion of soc N_x in D_k(A₀ e_x) to a map N_x → D_k(A₀ e_x). Its kernel is zero, since every nonzero submodule meets the socle. Equality of dimensions then makes it an isomorphism."

    The labels S_x, I_x and the three dimension identities are the inputs (InjData); they come from mod A through the graded Hom dimensions.
